response.answer: Once you receive your new Empire Gold plates, do not return your old plates to the DMV. Instead, recycle them according to your local guidelines. Before recycling, mark out the plate number with permanent ink or otherwise deface them, and put each plate in the recycling bin on different weeks to protect against fraudulent use.

# 关于帝国金色车牌的信息

# 关于帝国金色车牌的信息 [1]

自2010年4月1日起，DMV已发放帝国金色车辆牌照。DMV不再发放帝国蓝色和白色牌照。

### 续期注册时无需更换帝国金色车牌

您可以保留当前车牌，或订购帝国金色车牌。

### 何时有资格获得帝国金色车牌

在以下情况下，您将获得帝国金色车牌：

- 申请更换丢失或被盗的车牌
- 申请新的（原始）注册，且不转移另一辆车的车牌或注册
- 订购新的个性化车牌

您有权订购帝国金色车牌：

- 在线、邮寄或在DMV办公室续期注册时 [2]
- 更换当前车牌（当您的注册未到期续期时）

### 如何订购

您可以通过电话、在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金色车牌。新车牌和注册文件将分别邮寄给您。在大多数情况下，您会先收到新的注册文件，然后再收到车牌。

为避免交通罚单，即使新车牌尚未到达，也请将新的注册文件放置在您的车辆上。收到新车牌后，请尽快将其安装在您的车辆上。

在线订购时，您必须提供：

- 车辆车牌号
- 车辆类别
- 您的姓名
- 您的邮政编码（在DMV记录中）

在线订购帝国金色车牌 [4]

### 费用

您需要支付车牌费用

- 两片车牌套装为25美元
- 仅接收一片车牌的车辆（摩托车、拖车等）为12.50美元

您可能需要支付额外费用。当您的注册未到期续期时，更换车牌的费为3.75美元。

### 保留您的原车牌号码

如果您的车辆注册在以下列出的类别之一，您可以支付额外20.00美元的费用，将当前车牌号码保留在新的帝国金车牌上。

- 乘用车（PAS）
- 商用车（COM）
- 摩托车（MOT）
- 拖车（TRL）
- 其他特定注册类别 - 查看符合帝国金车牌资格并保留原车牌号码的注册类别列表 [5]

### 车牌费用

续期时，您无需获取新的帝国金车牌并支付车牌费用。您可以续期并保留当前车牌。

如果您需要新车牌，或选择获取新的帝国金车牌，您需要支付车牌费用。

- 两片车辆车牌的费用为25美元
- 单片车牌（例如拖车或摩托车车牌）的费用为12.50美元

当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

### 我有个性化车牌。如果我申请帝国金车牌，能否保留相同的车牌号码？

可以。您可以在续期注册时获取新的帝国金车牌并保留您的个性化车牌号码。

除了续期费用外，您还需要支付新车牌费用（两片新车牌为25美元，或接收单片车牌的车辆为12.50美元）。您不会因保留相同号码而被收取额外费用，因为您目前每年支付个性化车牌费用。

如果您的注册未到期续期，但您想订购帝国金个性化车牌以替换当前的个性化车牌，您可以在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金车牌。当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

### 如何处理您的旧帝国蓝白车牌

当您收到新的帝国金车牌时，请勿将旧车牌退回DMV。请根据当地指南回收旧车牌。

如需全州地方回收协调员名单，请访问纽约州环境保护部网站：http://www.dec.ny.gov/chemical/8511.html [6]。

在回收旧车牌之前，请使用永久性墨水标记划掉车牌号码或以其他方式污损车牌。为保护您自己，请将车牌分开，并在不同周放入回收箱。

# Order picture and professional plates

# Order picture and professional plates [1]

You can order picture or professional plates for passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and motorcycles. 1

Many picture or professional plates can also be personalized [2]. You can browse our collection of picture and professional plates and order online directly from the pages below. The categories are:

- I Love NY Adventure [3]
- Sports [4]
- Military and Veterans [5]
- Counties and Regions of NY State [6]
- Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [7]
- Causes [8]
- Professions [9]
- Organizations [10]
- Motorcycle Plates [11]

Learn more about picture and professional plates. [12]

### Order online

You can order many picture plates online, see the list above for more information on how to order a plate.

If you wish to purchase plates for people with disabilities that have the Universal Symbol of Access, you must contact the Custom Plates Unit. 2

All professional and military/veteran plates, and some organization picture plates require you to provide proof or certification that you are eligible. These plates must be ordered through the organization or the Custom Plates Unit.

To order picture or professional plates online:

- You must have a valid New York State vehicle registration in the passenger, commercial or motorcycle registration class that does not expire within 60 days. 3
- The mailing address on your vehicle registration record must be your current mailing address. 4
- Your vehicle registration record must match your current name if your name has changed. 5
- You must provide your current plate number, the 3-letter registration class code and the first three letters of your last name. See a sample registration document. [13]
- You must have a credit card that DMV accepts, and a valid email address for confirmation purposes. 6

### Order by mail

To order picture or professional plates by mail, use the Application for Custom Plates (pdf) [14] (CP-30). 7

Mail the completed form and your payment to:

NYS DMV Custom Plates UnitP.O. Box 2775Albany, NY 12220

### Order by phone

You can order by phone, however it s faster and easier to do it online. Call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday. 8

### Order at a DMV office

Yes, but you can save yourself trip. It s faster and easier to do it online.

Find a DMV office. [15]

Professional plates can only be ordered from the Custom Plates Unit with proper proof or certification. 9

### Receiving custom plates and registration

- In approximately 10 days or less after your order is processed, you will receive new documents that show your current plate number and your new plate combination.
- Allow at least six weeks for the custom plates to arrive.
- Your new registration documents will be mailed separately from your new custom plates

If you do not receive your registration documents within two weeks or your custom plates within six weeks, contact the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday.

Check my plate order mailing status. [16]

### Destroy your old plates

Once you receive your new plates you will want to destroy your old plates to protect against the fraudulent use. Mark each vehicle plate with a permanent marker. Do not put both vehicle plates in the recycling/garbage on the same day.

- 1. You can t order picture or professional plates before your vehicle is registered, when renewing your registration, or before transferring a registration. You must have a registration windshield sticker, receipt and regular series plates issued by DMV before ordering picture or professional plates.
- 2. Call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday.
- 3. If your registration expires within the next 60 days, renew your registration [17] before you order picture or professional plates.
- 4. Change your address online [18] before ordering picture or professional plates.
- 5. You must visit a DMV office [15] to change your name on all DMV records and documents. Learn more about how to change your name [19].
- 6. We accept American Express, Discover, MasterCard and VISA.
- 7. Some picture plates can t be purchased by mail.
- 8. Some plates are not available by phone. Professional, emergency services and some organization plates are limited to membership and must be ordered through the organization or directly from the Custom Plates Unit, with documentation.
- 9. Call the Custom Plates Unit at 1-518-402-4838. Office hours are 8:00am - 4:00pm, Monday through Friday.

# 注册（Registrations）

您的“注册”是指贴在挡风玻璃上的贴纸以及必须放在车内的纸质注册证书。

您或您的企业必须在 DMV 办公室为您拥有或租赁的任何车辆进行注册和所有权登记（title）。注册不需要以车主名义进行，也不限于一人。汽车经销商可以办理车辆注册和所有权登记，并发放车牌（并为此收取费用）。

查看关于车辆牌照 [1] 或车辆所有权（title）[2] 的信息。

### 已在纽约注册的车辆

#### 续期（Renew）

您可以在线续期注册，并打印一份 10 天的临时文件，在新注册文件邮寄到达前使用。请注意：如果您的车辆经过改装或加长以增加乘客数量，或存在其他特殊情况，则无法在线续期注册。查看更多信息及其他续期方式 [3]。

在线续期注册 [4]

#### 其他业务

- 更改地址 [5]
- 更改姓名或其他信息 [6]
- 查询注册状态 [7]
- 更换注册文件 [8]（并获取临时文件）
- 交回（退还）车牌并取消注册 [9]
- 告知 DMV 您的新注册文件尚未邮寄到达 [10]
- 将注册转移到您拥有的另一辆车 [11]

#### 暂停（Suspensions）

查看因以下原因导致的注册暂停信息：

- 停车罚单 [12] 1
- 过路费违规 [13]
- 保险中断 [14]

### 在纽约注册车辆

您或您的企业必须在 DMV 办公室注册您拥有的任何车辆。2 查看注册车辆的一般信息 [15] 以及不同车辆类型的特定要求 [16]。

#### 注册所需材料

完成 DMV 的 Document Guide，确保您在前往 DMV 之前备齐正确的身份证明和其他文件。

查找您的证明文件 [17]

#### 特殊情况

- 农业和农用车辆 [18]
- 车主已故 [19]
- 自制车辆和拖车 [20]
- 进口车辆 [21]
- 多位车主或注册人 [22]
- 新购车辆无所有权证书 [23]
- 皮卡作为“乘用车”类别 [24]
- 为他人注册车辆 [25]
- 在外州时注册车辆 [26]
- 注册外州车辆 [27]

### 更多信息

- 废弃和无主车辆 [28]
- 申请Clean Pass [29]
- 在纽约无法注册的机动设备 [30]
- 授权书 [31]
- 将车辆所有权转让给他人 [32]
- 车辆改装和注册类别 [33]
- 报废车辆 [34]

### 资源

- DMV监管的企业 [35]（检查站、经销商和运输商、修理厂等）
- 判断车辆是否被水淹或被盗 [36]
- 如果家庭成员去世 [37]
- 军人和退伍军人资源 [38]
- 搬到纽约或搬出纽约 [39]
- 购车提示 [40]

- 1. DMV不处理停车违规或管理停车事宜。如果您收到停车罚单，必须向开具罚单的地方政府回应。**不要联系DMV**。如果您不处理停车罚单，地方政府可以通知DMV，DMV可能会阻止您更新车辆注册或暂停您的车辆注册。查看纽约州当地交通法庭列表 [41]

- 2. 这包括所有类型的车辆（如果您计划在公共道路上驾驶它们）

- 汽车
  - SUV
  - 面包车
  - 皮卡
  - 摩托车
  - 拖车
  - 定制和自制拖车
  - 农业和农用车辆
  - 船只
  - ATV
  - 轻便摩托车
  - 雪地摩托

有些机动设备在纽约无法注册 [30]。

# 订购个性化车牌

# 订购个性化车牌 [1]

### 如何订购个性化车牌？

您可以为乘用车、商用车和摩托车订购个性化车牌。1

了解更多关于个性化车牌费用、要求和限制的信息。[2]

许多图片车牌也可以个性化。您可以在线浏览我们的图片车牌系列。类别包括：

- I Love NY Adventure [3]
- Sports [4]
- Military and Veterans [5]
- Counties and Regions of NY State [6]
- Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [7]
- Causes [8]
- Professions [9]
- Organizations [10]
- Motorcycle Plates [11]

### 在线订购

您可以在线订购个性化车牌，除非您想要为残疾人定制带有Universal Symbol of Access的个性化车牌。2

要在线订购个性化车牌：

- 您必须拥有有效的New York State车辆注册，属于乘用车、商用车或摩托车注册类别，且有效期不少于60天。3
- 您车辆注册记录上的邮寄地址必须是您当前的邮寄地址。4
- 如果您的姓名已更改，您的车辆注册记录必须与您当前姓名一致。5
- 您必须提供当前车牌号、3字母注册类别代码以及您姓氏的前三个字母。请参阅示例注册文件。[12]
- 您必须拥有DMV接受的信用卡，以及用于确认的有效电子邮件地址。6

在线订购个性化车牌 [13]

### 通过邮件

要通过邮件订购个性化车牌，请使用Application for Custom Plates (PDF) [14] (CP-30)。7

将填写完整的表格和付款邮寄至：

NYS DMV Custom Plates UnitP.O. Box 2775Albany, NY 12220

### 通过电话

在线办理更快更容易。要通过电话订购，请拨打Custom Plates Unit电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。8

### 在 DMV 办公室

您可以省去一趟行程。在线办理更快、更简单。

查找 DMV 办公室。[15]

### 何时收到新牌照和注册文件

- 在您的订单处理完成后约 10 天或更短时间内，您将收到新的注册文件，其中显示您当前的牌照号码和新的牌照组合。
- 定制牌照至少需要六周时间才能送达
- 您的新注册文件将与新定制牌照分开邮寄
- 如果您在两周内未收到注册文件，或在六周内未收到定制牌照，请联系 Custom Plates Unit，电话 1-518-402-4838。

检查我的牌照订单邮寄状态。[16]

### 收到新牌照后如何处理当前车辆牌照

为防止当前车辆牌照被欺诈使用，请用永久性墨水笔在每个车辆牌照上做标记。不要在同一天将两个车辆牌照放入回收/垃圾中。

- 1. 在车辆注册之前、续期注册时或转移注册之前，您不能订购个性化牌照。您必须拥有 DMV 颁发的注册挡风玻璃贴纸、收据和普通系列牌照，才能订购个性化牌照。
- 2. 要为带有 Universal Symbol of Access 的残障人士订购个性化牌照，请致电 Custom Plates Unit，电话 1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午 8:00 至下午 4:00。
- 3. 如果您的注册将在未来 60 天内到期，请在订购个性化牌照之前续期您的注册 [17]。
- 4. 在订购个性化牌照之前，请在线更改您的地址 [18]。
- 5. 您必须前往 DMV 办公室 [15] 更改所有 DMV 记录和文件上的姓名。了解更多关于如何更改姓名 [19] 的信息。
- 6. 我们接受 American Express、Discover、MasterCard 和 VISA。
- 7. 某些图片或专业牌照不能通过邮寄购买。
- 8. 某些牌照不能通过电话订购。Professional、emergency services、veterans 和某些组织牌照仅限于会员，必须通过组织或直接从 Custom Plates Unit 订购，并附有文件。

# Transfer IRP registration

# Transfer IRP registration [1]

To transfer an IRP registration and apportioned plates, request that the IRB transfer the registration when you buy or register the new vehicle.

### Transfer IRP registration online

You can apply to transfer an IRP registration online through the New York State One Stop Credentialing and Registration system (OSCAR). For more information go to https://www.oscar.ny.gov/OSCR/OSCRCarrierHome [2].

### Transfer an IRP registration by mail

To apply for transfer of an IRP registration mail the following

- completed and signed form Schedule A & C (pdf) [3] (IRP-6) 1
- proof of:
  - ownership and proof of insurance (form FS-20) for the new vehicle being added to your account
  - clearance of the Heavy Vehicle Use Tax (IRS form 2290) if applicable
  - proof of identity2
- the original cab card for the vehicle being removed from the fleet
- the appropriate fee

If you are using the United States Postal Service use this address

International Registration BureauPO Box 2850 ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0850

If you use an **express mail service** or other method, use this address

International Registration BureauNYS DMVRoom 1366 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

### Transfer an IRP registration at the Customer Service Counter in Albany

You may bring the items described above to

Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

The office is open from 8:00am to 3:45pm, Monday through Friday, except state holidays

### Transfer an IRP registration by fax

Fax the items described above to the IRB at518-486-6579

### How much will the transfer cost?

Fees are calculated by member jurisdictions using different methods. The NY State IRB cannot calculate the amount of your bill until the transfer has been processed

### When will the new registration expire?

The new registration expires on the same date as the original registration.

### What if the new vehicle weighs more than the previous vehicle?

If the new vehicle weighs more than the previous vehicle, there are pro-rated registration fees for the difference in weight, administrative fees for the vehicle plate transfer and fees for any fee increases that may have occurred since the original registration was issued.

### What should I do with the original cab card?

The original cab card for the vehicle being removed from your fleet must be sent to the IRB.

### What if I do not transfer the registration immediately?

If you do not transfer the registration immediately, surrender the apportioned plates and cab card to the IRB. Your vehicle registration will be suspended if there is a lapse of liability insurance and the apportioned plates were not surrendered. The driver license of the registrant can also be suspended.See Section 9.0 of the NY State IRP Manual (pdf) [4] (IRP-8) for complete instructions on registration transfers.

- 1. In Part 1, Type of Application Requested, check TRANSFER PLATES, and complete the Carrier, Fleet, Weight and Vehicle Information sections on the form
- 2. If you apply by mail, send photocopies of your proofs of identity. If another person brings your application to the Customer Service Counter, see the requirements for a second-party registration application.

## Do it by phone:

You can't transfer an IRP registration by phone. You may call the IRB with questions at 1-518-473-5834.

## Do it by mail:

You can transfer your IRP registration by mail. Follow the instructions on this page and Schedule A&C [3] (IRP-6).

## Do it at the DMV:

You can transfer an IRP registration at the

Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

The Customer Service Counter is open 8:00am to 3:45pm, Monday through Friday, except state holidays

You can't transfer an IRP registration at a DMV local office.

## Do it by fax:

You can fax the items described on this page to the IRB at 518-486-6579.

# 关于帝国金色车牌的信息

# 关于帝国金色车牌的信息 [1]

自2010年4月1日起，DMV已发放帝国金色车辆牌照。DMV不再发放帝国蓝色和白色牌照。

### 续期注册时无需更换帝国金色车牌

您可以保留当前车牌，或订购帝国金色车牌。

### 何时有资格获得帝国金色车牌

在以下情况下，您将获得帝国金色车牌：

- 申请更换丢失或被盗的车牌
- 申请新的（原始）注册，且不转移另一辆车的车牌或注册
- 订购新的个性化车牌

您有权订购帝国金色车牌：

- 在线、邮寄或在DMV办公室续期注册时 [2]
- 更换当前车牌（当您的注册未到期续期时）

### 如何订购

您可以通过电话、在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金色车牌。新车牌和注册文件将分别邮寄给您。在大多数情况下，您会先收到新的注册文件，然后再收到车牌。

为避免交通罚单，即使新车牌尚未到达，也请将新的注册文件放置在您的车辆上。收到新车牌后，请尽快将其安装在您的车辆上。

在线订购时，您必须提供：

- 车辆车牌号
- 车辆类别
- 您的姓名
- 您的邮政编码（在DMV记录中）

在线订购帝国金色车牌 [4]

### 费用

您需要支付车牌费用

- 两片车牌套装为25美元
- 仅接收一片车牌的车辆（摩托车、拖车等）为12.50美元

您可能需要支付额外费用。当您的注册未到期续期时，更换车牌的费为3.75美元。

### 保留您的原车牌号码

如果您的车辆注册在以下列出的类别之一，您可以支付额外20.00美元的费用，将当前车牌号码保留在新的帝国金车牌上。

- 乘用车（PAS）
- 商用车（COM）
- 摩托车（MOT）
- 拖车（TRL）
- 其他特定注册类别 - 查看符合帝国金车牌资格并保留原车牌号码的注册类别列表 [5]

### 车牌费用

续期时，您无需获取新的帝国金车牌并支付车牌费用。您可以续期并保留当前车牌。

如果您需要新车牌，或选择获取新的帝国金车牌，您需要支付车牌费用。

- 两片车辆车牌的费用为25美元
- 单片车牌（例如拖车或摩托车车牌）的费用为12.50美元

当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

### 我有个性化车牌。如果我申请帝国金车牌，能否保留相同的车牌号码？

可以。您可以在续期注册时获取新的帝国金车牌并保留您的个性化车牌号码。

除了续期费用外，您还需要支付新车牌费用（两片新车牌为25美元，或接收单片车牌的车辆为12.50美元）。您不会因保留相同号码而被收取额外费用，因为您目前每年支付个性化车牌费用。

如果您的注册未到期续期，但您想订购帝国金个性化车牌以替换当前的个性化车牌，您可以在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金车牌。当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

### 如何处理您的旧帝国蓝白车牌

当您收到新的帝国金车牌时，请勿将旧车牌退回DMV。请根据当地指南回收旧车牌。

如需全州地方回收协调员名单，请访问纽约州环境保护部网站：http://www.dec.ny.gov/chemical/8511.html [6]。

在回收旧车牌之前，请使用永久性墨水标记划掉车牌号码或以其他方式污损车牌。为保护您自己，请将车牌分开，并在不同周放入回收箱。

# Transfer IRP registration

# Transfer IRP registration [1]

To transfer an IRP registration and apportioned plates, request that the IRB transfer the registration when you buy or register the new vehicle.

### Transfer IRP registration online

You can apply to transfer an IRP registration online through the New York State One Stop Credentialing and Registration system (OSCAR). For more information go to https://www.oscar.ny.gov/OSCR/OSCRCarrierHome [2].

### Transfer an IRP registration by mail

To apply for transfer of an IRP registration mail the following

- completed and signed form Schedule A & C (pdf) [3] (IRP-6) 1
- proof of:
  - ownership and proof of insurance (form FS-20) for the new vehicle being added to your account
  - clearance of the Heavy Vehicle Use Tax (IRS form 2290) if applicable
  - proof of identity2
- the original cab card for the vehicle being removed from the fleet
- the appropriate fee

If you are using the United States Postal Service use this address

International Registration BureauPO Box 2850 ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0850

If you use an **express mail service** or other method, use this address

International Registration BureauNYS DMVRoom 1366 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

### Transfer an IRP registration at the Customer Service Counter in Albany

You may bring the items described above to

Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

The office is open from 8:00am to 3:45pm, Monday through Friday, except state holidays

### Transfer an IRP registration by fax

Fax the items described above to the IRB at518-486-6579

### How much will the transfer cost?

Fees are calculated by member jurisdictions using different methods. The NY State IRB cannot calculate the amount of your bill until the transfer has been processed

### When will the new registration expire?

The new registration expires on the same date as the original registration.

### What if the new vehicle weighs more than the previous vehicle?

If the new vehicle weighs more than the previous vehicle, there are pro-rated registration fees for the difference in weight, administrative fees for the vehicle plate transfer and fees for any fee increases that may have occurred since the original registration was issued.

### What should I do with the original cab card?

The original cab card for the vehicle being removed from your fleet must be sent to the IRB.

### What if I do not transfer the registration immediately?

If you do not transfer the registration immediately, surrender the apportioned plates and cab card to the IRB. Your vehicle registration will be suspended if there is a lapse of liability insurance and the apportioned plates were not surrendered. The driver license of the registrant can also be suspended.See Section 9.0 of the NY State IRP Manual (pdf) [4] (IRP-8) for complete instructions on registration transfers.

- 1. In Part 1, Type of Application Requested, check TRANSFER PLATES, and complete the Carrier, Fleet, Weight and Vehicle Information sections on the form
- 2. If you apply by mail, send photocopies of your proofs of identity. If another person brings your application to the Customer Service Counter, see the requirements for a second-party registration application.

## Do it by phone:

You can't transfer an IRP registration by phone. You may call the IRB with questions at 1-518-473-5834.

## Do it by mail:

You can transfer your IRP registration by mail. Follow the instructions on this page and Schedule A&C [3] (IRP-6).

## Do it at the DMV:

You can transfer an IRP registration at the

Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

The Customer Service Counter is open 8:00am to 3:45pm, Monday through Friday, except state holidays

You can't transfer an IRP registration at a DMV local office.

## Do it by fax:

You can fax the items described on this page to the IRB at 518-486-6579.

# 关于帝国金色车牌的信息

# 关于帝国金色车牌的信息 [1]

自2010年4月1日起，DMV已发放帝国金色车辆牌照。DMV不再发放帝国蓝色和白色牌照。

### 续期注册时无需更换帝国金色车牌

您可以保留当前车牌，或订购帝国金色车牌。

### 何时有资格获得帝国金色车牌

在以下情况下，您将获得帝国金色车牌：

- 申请更换丢失或被盗的车牌
- 申请新的（原始）注册，且不转移另一辆车的车牌或注册
- 订购新的个性化车牌

您有权订购帝国金色车牌：

- 在线、邮寄或在DMV办公室续期注册时 [2]
- 更换当前车牌（当您的注册未到期续期时）

### 如何订购

您可以通过电话、在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金色车牌。新车牌和注册文件将分别邮寄给您。在大多数情况下，您会先收到新的注册文件，然后再收到车牌。

为避免交通罚单，即使新车牌尚未到达，也请将新的注册文件放置在您的车辆上。收到新车牌后，请尽快将其安装在您的车辆上。

在线订购时，您必须提供：

- 车辆车牌号
- 车辆类别
- 您的姓名
- 您的邮政编码（在DMV记录中）

在线订购帝国金色车牌 [4]

### 费用

您需要支付车牌费用

- 两片车牌套装为25美元
- 仅接收一片车牌的车辆（摩托车、拖车等）为12.50美元

您可能需要支付额外费用。当您的注册未到期续期时，更换车牌的费为3.75美元。

### 保留您的原车牌号码

如果您的车辆注册在以下列出的类别之一，您可以支付额外20.00美元的费用，将当前车牌号码保留在新的帝国金车牌上。

- 乘用车（PAS）
- 商用车（COM）
- 摩托车（MOT）
- 拖车（TRL）
- 其他特定注册类别 - 查看符合帝国金车牌资格并保留原车牌号码的注册类别列表 [5]

### 车牌费用

续期时，您无需获取新的帝国金车牌并支付车牌费用。您可以续期并保留当前车牌。

如果您需要新车牌，或选择获取新的帝国金车牌，您需要支付车牌费用。

- 两片车辆车牌的费用为25美元
- 单片车牌（例如拖车或摩托车车牌）的费用为12.50美元

当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

### 我有个性化车牌。如果我申请帝国金车牌，能否保留相同的车牌号码？

可以。您可以在续期注册时获取新的帝国金车牌并保留您的个性化车牌号码。

除了续期费用外，您还需要支付新车牌费用（两片新车牌为25美元，或接收单片车牌的车辆为12.50美元）。您不会因保留相同号码而被收取额外费用，因为您目前每年支付个性化车牌费用。

如果您的注册未到期续期，但您想订购帝国金个性化车牌以替换当前的个性化车牌，您可以在线或在DMV办公室订购帝国金车牌。当没有注册续期时，订购帝国金车牌需额外支付3.75美元的车牌更换交易费。

### 如何处理您的旧帝国蓝白车牌

当您收到新的帝国金车牌时，请勿将旧车牌退回DMV。请根据当地指南回收旧车牌。

如需全州地方回收协调员名单，请访问纽约州环境保护部网站：http://www.dec.ny.gov/chemical/8511.html [6]。

在回收旧车牌之前，请使用永久性墨水标记划掉车牌号码或以其他方式污损车牌。为保护您自己，请将车牌分开，并在不同周放入回收箱。
